title: Backup and Restore
unavailable: Cannot refresh. Displayed information may be out of date.
applicationsNeedRecovery: Applications need restart; inspect the service log
noPlansHelp: Connect a repository, then choose data and a schedule.
repositoryHelp: Use a dedicated folder. Reconnect an existing encrypted repository with its original password.
waitForOperation: An operation is running. Wait before reading the repository.
recoveryHelp: Keep the repository address and password outside this NAS. A replacement system must be able to reach the backup independently.
recoveryStep1: Install a supported operating system and the matching PaNasMs version on the replacement medium.
recoveryStep2: Reconnect the data disks without formatting them, then connect the backup repository.
recoveryStep3: Verify the archive, restore the platform copy into a separate folder and inspect recovery.json.
recoveryStep4: Apply reviewed configuration and databases while their services are stopped, then verify login, storage and applications.
recoveryUnverified: Archive verification does not prove that a replacement system will boot. A recovery rehearsal must be recorded separately.
planHelp: Choose sources, schedule and how many versions to retain.
name: Name
connectAccount: Connect an account in your profile
networkHelp: Connect SMB/NFS shares, including Synology, in Storage first.
cloudFolderHelp: Enter a dedicated folder relative to the cloud root, for example PaNasMs/Backups.
passwordHelp: Use at least eight characters. This password is needed to recover data after losing the NAS. It cannot be recovered from the encrypted archive.
keySaved: I have stored this password outside the NAS.
filesHelp: File copies are not application-consistent. Select each mounted filesystem separately.
sqliteHelp: Uses SQLite online backup, including committed WAL data.
containerHelp: Selected containers stop while their persistent data and image are copied. Include every writer to shared storage.
postgresHelp: Runs pg_dumpall inside the container. Each database has a consistent dump; there is no single transaction across databases.
mysqlHelp: Runs a logical dump inside the container with global table locks. Writes may wait until the dump finishes.
platformHelp: Captures platform databases, configuration and a system inventory. This is not a bootable disk image.
downtime: Allow these applications to stop during backup and restart afterward.
retentionHelp: After a successful backup and repository check, versions outside these rules are removed. At least the latest copy remains.
restoreHelp: Restore into a new private folder. Existing files and running applications will not be replaced. The result path appears in history.
checkHelp: Read and verify all encrypted data. This may take time and wake the backup disks.
runHelp: Run this plan in the background, including its configured application downtime and retention rules.
githubHelp: Use an existing private repository (owner/name). Configuration only, up to 32 MiB encrypted per version. Copies are stored as draft release assets, outside Git history.
restoreApplicationsHelp: Recreate stopped application copies with their files. They have no network or published ports. Review them in Containers before starting. Original applications are preserved.
workingDiskHelp: Choose a disk for temporary application copies and restored files. Existing restores stay in their original location. Operations stop when less than 2 GiB remains. Allow enough space for a complete application copy.
captureCancellation: Cancellation becomes available after consistent application capture.
